# Lab 12.8: Matrix Factorisation Recommendations

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a product recommender from purchase history with matrix factorisation (implicit feedback). Training this model type needs an Enterprise or Enterprise Plus reservation.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Build user–product interactions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab12.user_product AS
SELECT user_id, product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchases
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`
GROUP BY user_id, product_id;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Make sure training can use a reservation.** If you don't have one, create a small reservation with an `ML_EXTERNAL`/`QUERY` assignment as in Lab 21.2, then delete it after training.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls --reservation --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Train the model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.recommender
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'MATRIX_FACTORIZATION',
  feedback_type = 'IMPLICIT',
  user_col = 'user_id', item_col = 'product_id', rating_col = 'purchases',
  num_factors = 16, l2_reg = 10, wals_alpha = 25
) AS
SELECT user_id, product_id, purchases FROM lab12.user_product;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Top 5 products for one user.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT user_id, product_id, predicted_purchases_confidence
FROM ML.RECOMMEND(MODEL lab12.recommender, (SELECT 1234 AS user_id))
ORDER BY predicted_purchases_confidence DESC
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[SQL] Add product names.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT r.product_id, p.name, p.category, ROUND(r.predicted_purchases_confidence, 3) AS score
FROM ML.RECOMMEND(MODEL lab12.recommender, (SELECT 1234 AS user_id)) r
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = r.product_id
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Feedback | Implicit (purchases, not ratings) |
| Factors | 16 hidden factors per user and product |
| `ML.RECOMMEND` | Ranked products per user |
| Requirement | Reservation for training |
